ComponentValueImportOptions.description: An invocation's choice of which declared component value imports apply.

enabled.description: `false` applies none of the component's value imports. Defaults to `true`.

exclude.description: Names of value imports to skip. Every name must be declared by the component.

description:
Expands a chart identified by a dynamic resource kind into Kubernetes manifests.

The kind is a local component path or remote chart shortcut, not the literal `Component`. The spec supplies chart values; the selected chart defines its input contract.

## When needed

Use this optional resource to invoke a chart through a local component kind or a remote chart shortcut.

## If omitted

Charts in component search paths are not rendered until invoked. A HelmChart can render a chart through explicit coordinates instead; authored Kubernetes manifests need no component invocation.

apiVersion.description: API group and version for chart-backed component invocations.

kind.description: Relative path under `components/` that identifies the Helm chart

metadata.description: Helm release name, namespace, labels, and annotations.

spec.description: Helm values — defaults to an empty object when omitted

valueImports.description:
Opt this invocation out of the value imports its component declares.

A local component may declare value imports in `nyl-component.yaml`, which supply chart value defaults from the effective Cluster and DeploymentTarget `values`. Imports are enabled unless this field turns them off; invocation `spec` values override imported defaults either way.
